Title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Public preview updates for January 2022

Body.Content:
In January 2022, the following preview updates and enhancements were made to Microsoft Defender for Cloud (formerly Azure Security Center):

  • Recommendations to enable Microsoft Defender plans on workspaces (in preview)
  • Auto provision Log Analytics agent to Azure Arc-enabled machines (preview)
